<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"><B>Item 1. Description of Registrant&rsquo;s Securities to be Registered.</B></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-indent: 0.5in">The securities to be registered hereby are the
Series&nbsp;A Liberty SiriusXM common stock, par value $0.01 per share (the &ldquo;<U>Series&nbsp;A Liberty SiriusXM common stock</U>&rdquo;),
the Series&nbsp;B Liberty SiriusXM common stock, par value $0.01 per share (the &ldquo;<U>Series&nbsp;B Liberty SiriusXM common stock</U>&rdquo;),
the Series&nbsp;C Liberty SiriusXM common stock, par value $0.01 per share (the &ldquo;<U>Series&nbsp;C Liberty SiriusXM common stock</U>&rdquo;
and, together with the Series&nbsp;A Liberty SiriusXM common stock and Series&nbsp;B Liberty SiriusXM common stock, the &ldquo;<U>Liberty
SiriusXM common stock</U>&rdquo;), the Series&nbsp;A Liberty Live common stock, par value $0.01 per share (the &ldquo;<U>Series&nbsp;A
Liberty Live common stock</U>&rdquo;), the Series&nbsp;C Liberty Live common stock, par value $0.01 per share (the &ldquo;<U>Series&nbsp;C
Liberty Live common stock</U>&rdquo;), the Series&nbsp;A Liberty Formula One common stock, par value $0.01 per share (the &ldquo;<U>Series&nbsp;A
Liberty Formula One common stock</U>&rdquo;), and the Series&nbsp;C Liberty Formula One common stock, par value $0.01 per share (the &ldquo;<U>Series&nbsp;C
Liberty Formula One common stock</U>&rdquo;) of Liberty Media Corporation (the &ldquo;<U>Registrant</U>&rdquo;). The Registrant has applied
to list the Liberty SiriusXM common stock, the Series&nbsp;A Liberty Live common stock, the Series&nbsp;C Liberty Live common stock, the
Series&nbsp;A Liberty Formula One common stock and the Series&nbsp;C Liberty Formula One common stock on the Nasdaq Global Select Market
under the symbols &ldquo;LSXMA,&rdquo; &ldquo;LSXMB,&rdquo; &ldquo;LSXMK,&rdquo; &ldquo;LLYVA,&rdquo; &ldquo;LLYVK,&rdquo; &ldquo;FWONA,&rdquo;
and &ldquo;FWONK,&rdquo; respectively.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-indent: 0.5in">Reference is made to the Registrant&rsquo;s Registration
Statement on Form&nbsp;S-4 (File No.&nbsp;333-268921), which was initially filed with the Securities and Exchange Commission (the &ldquo;<U>SEC</U>&rdquo;)
on December&nbsp;21, 2022 and declared effective by the SEC on June&nbsp;9, 2023.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-indent: 0.5in">A description of the Liberty SiriusXM common stock,
the Series&nbsp;A Liberty Live common stock, the Series&nbsp;C Liberty Live common stock, the Series&nbsp;A Liberty Formula One common
stock and the Series&nbsp;C Liberty Formula One common stock as set forth in the Registrant&rsquo;s Restated Certificate of Incorporation
(the &ldquo;<U>charter</U>&rdquo;) is set forth below. The following description is qualified by reference to the full text of the charter,
which is incorporated by reference as Exhibit&nbsp;3.1 to this Form&nbsp;8-A.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"><B><U>Liberty SiriusXM Common Stock</U></B></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"><B><I>Basic Investment</I></B></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-indent: 0.5in">The Liberty SiriusXM common stock is intended to
track and reflect the separate economic performance of the businesses, assets and liabilities attributed to the Liberty SiriusXM Group.
The Liberty SiriusXM Group is defined in the charter to include (i)&nbsp;the Registrant&rsquo;s direct and indirect interest, as of the
effective date of the charter, in Sirius XM Holdings Inc. and each of its subsidiaries (including any successor to Sirius XM Holdings
Inc. or any such subsidiary by merger, consolidation or sale, transfer, exchange, assignment or other disposition of all or substantially
all of its assets, whether or not in connection with a SiriusXM Group Related Business Transaction (as such term is defined in the charter))
and their respective assets, liabilities and businesses, (ii)&nbsp;all other assets, liabilities and businesses of the Registrant or any
of its subsidiaries to the extent attributed to the Liberty SiriusXM Group as of the effective date of the charter, (iii)&nbsp;such other
businesses, assets and liabilities that the Registrant&rsquo;s board of directors (the &ldquo;<U>board</U>&rdquo;) may determine to attribute
to the Liberty SiriusXM Group or that may be acquired for or transferred to the Liberty SiriusXM Group in the future, (iv)&nbsp;the proceeds
of any sale, transfer, exchange, assignment or other disposition of any of the foregoing, (v)&nbsp;an Inter-Group Interest in the Liberty
Live Group equal to one (1)&nbsp;minus the Live Group Outstanding Interest Fraction allocable to the Liberty SiriusXM Group as of such
date (as such terms are defined in the charter) and (vi)&nbsp;an Inter-Group Interest in the Formula One Group equal to one (1)&nbsp;minus
the Formula One Group Outstanding Interest Fraction allocable to the Liberty SiriusXM Group as of such date (as such terms are defined
in the charter).</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"><B><I>Authorized Capital Stock</I></B></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-indent: 0.5in">The Registrant is authorized to issue up to 4.075
billion shares of Liberty SiriusXM common stock, of which 2 billion are designated as Series&nbsp;A Liberty SiriusXM common stock, 75
million are designated as Series&nbsp;B Liberty SiriusXM common stock, and 2 billion are designated as Series&nbsp;C Liberty SiriusXM
common stock.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"></P>

<!-- Field: Page; Sequence: 2; Options: NewSection; Value: 1 -->
    <DIV STYLE="margin-top: 12pt; margin-bottom: 6pt; border-bottom: Black 1pt solid"><P STYLE="font-size: 10pt; text-align: center; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt"><!-- Field: Sequence; Type: Arabic; Name: PageNo -->1<!-- Field: /Sequence -->&nbsp;</P></DIV>
    <DIV STYLE="break-before: page; margin-top: 6pt; margin-bottom: 12pt"><P STYLE="margin: 0pt">&nbsp;</P></DIV>
    <!-- Field: /Page -->

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"><B><I>Dividends and Securities Distributions</I></B></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-indent: 0.5in">The Registrant is permitted to pay dividends on
Liberty SiriusXM common stock out of the lesser of its assets legally available for the payment of dividends under Delaware law and the
 &ldquo;SiriusXM Group Available Dividend Amount&rdquo; (defined generally as the excess of the total assets less the total liabilities
of the Liberty SiriusXM Group over the par value, or any greater amount determined to be capital in respect of, all outstanding shares
of Liberty SiriusXM common stock or, if there is no such excess, an amount equal to the earnings or loss attributable to the Liberty SiriusXM
Group (if positive) for the fiscal year in which such dividend is to be paid and/or the preceding fiscal year). If dividends are paid
on any series of Liberty SiriusXM common stock, an equal per share dividend will be concurrently paid on the other series of Liberty SiriusXM
common stock.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-indent: 0.5in">The Registrant is permitted to make (i)&nbsp;share
distributions of (A)&nbsp;Series&nbsp;C Liberty SiriusXM common stock to holders of all series of Liberty SiriusXM common stock, on an
equal per share basis; and (B)&nbsp;Series&nbsp;A Liberty SiriusXM common stock to holders of Series&nbsp;A Liberty SiriusXM common stock
and, on an equal per share basis, shares of Series&nbsp;B Liberty SiriusXM common stock to holders of Series&nbsp;B Liberty SiriusXM common
stock and, on an equal per share basis, shares of Series&nbsp;C Liberty SiriusXM common stock to holders of Series&nbsp;C Liberty SiriusXM
common stock; and (ii)&nbsp;share distributions of (A)&nbsp;Series&nbsp;C Liberty Live common stock or Series&nbsp;C Liberty Formula One
common stock to holders of all series of Liberty SiriusXM common stock, on an equal per share basis, subject to certain limitations; and
(B)&nbsp;Series&nbsp;A Liberty Live common stock or Series&nbsp;A Liberty Formula One common stock to holders of Series&nbsp;A Liberty
SiriusXM common stock and, on an equal per share basis, shares of Series&nbsp;B Liberty Live common stock, par value $0.01 per share (the
 &ldquo;<U>Series&nbsp;B Liberty Live common stock</U>&rdquo; and, together with the Series&nbsp;A Liberty Live common stock and Series&nbsp;C
Liberty Live common stock, the &ldquo;<U>Liberty Live common stock</U>&rdquo;) or Series&nbsp;B Liberty Formula One common stock, par
value $0.01 per share (the &ldquo;<U>Series&nbsp;B Liberty Formula One common stock</U>&rdquo; and, together with the Series&nbsp;A Liberty
Formula One common stock and Series&nbsp;C Liberty Formula One common stock, the &ldquo;<U>Liberty Formula One common stock</U>&rdquo;)
to holders of Series&nbsp;B Liberty SiriusXM common stock and, on an equal per share basis, shares of Series&nbsp;C Liberty Live common
stock or Series&nbsp;C Liberty Formula One common stock to holders of Series&nbsp;C Liberty SiriusXM common stock, in each case, subject
to certain limitations; and (iii)&nbsp;share distributions of any other class or series of the Registrant&rsquo;s securities or the securities
of any other person to holders of all series of Liberty SiriusXM common stock, on an equal per share basis, subject to certain limitations.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"><B><I>Conversion at Option of Holder</I></B></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-indent: 0.5in">Each share of Series&nbsp;B Liberty SiriusXM common
stock is convertible, at the option of the holder, into one share of Series&nbsp;A Liberty SiriusXM common stock. Shares of Series&nbsp;A
Liberty SiriusXM common stock and Series&nbsp;C Liberty SiriusXM common stock are not convertible at the option of the holder.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"><B><I>Conversion at Option of Issuer</I></B></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-indent: 0.5in">The Registrant can convert each share of Liberty
SiriusXM common stock into a number of shares of the corresponding series of Liberty Live common stock or Liberty Formula One common stock
at a ratio based on the relative trading prices of the Series&nbsp;A Liberty SiriusXM common stock (or another series of Liberty SiriusXM
common stock, subject to certain limitations) and the Series&nbsp;A Liberty Live common stock or Series&nbsp;A Liberty Formula One common
stock (or another series of Liberty Live common stock or Liberty Formula One common stock, subject to certain limitations) over a specified
20-trading day period.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-indent: 0.5in">The Registrant also can convert each share of Liberty
Live common stock or Liberty Formula One common stock into a number of shares of the corresponding series of Liberty SiriusXM common stock
at a ratio based on the relative trading prices of the Series&nbsp;A Liberty Live common stock (or another series of Liberty Live common
stock, subject to certain limitations) or Series&nbsp;A Liberty Formula One common stock (or another series of Liberty Formula One common
stock, subject to certain limitations) to the Series&nbsp;A Liberty SiriusXM common stock (or another series of Liberty SiriusXM common
stock, subject to certain limitations) over a specified 20-trading day period.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"></P>

<!-- Field: Page; Sequence: 3; Value: 1 -->
    <DIV STYLE="margin-top: 12pt; margin-bottom: 6pt; border-bottom: Black 1pt solid"><P STYLE="font-size: 10pt; text-align: center; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt"><!-- Field: Sequence; Type: Arabic; Name: PageNo -->2<!-- Field: /Sequence -->&nbsp;</P></DIV>
    <DIV STYLE="break-before: page; margin-top: 6pt; margin-bottom: 12pt"><P STYLE="margin: 0pt">&nbsp;</P></DIV>
    <!-- Field: /Page -->

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"><B><I>Optional Redemption for Stock of a Subsidiary</I></B></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-indent: 0.5in">The Registrant may redeem outstanding shares of
Liberty SiriusXM common stock for shares of common stock of a subsidiary that holds assets and liabilities attributed to the Liberty SiriusXM
Group (and may or may not hold assets and liabilities attributed to the Liberty Live Group or the Formula One Group), provided that the
board seeks and receives the approval to such redemption of holders of Liberty SiriusXM common stock, voting together as a separate class.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-indent: 0.5in">If the Registrant were to effect a redemption as
described above with stock of a subsidiary that also holds assets and liabilities of the Liberty Live Group and/or the Formula One Group,
shares of Liberty Live common stock and/or Liberty Formula One common stock would also be redeemed in exchange for shares of that subsidiary,
and the entire redemption would be subject to the voting rights of the holders of Liberty SiriusXM common stock described above as well
as the separate class vote of the holders of Liberty Live common stock and/or Liberty Formula One common stock, as the case may be.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"><B><I>Mandatory Dividend, Redemption and Conversion Rights on Disposition
of Assets</I></B></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-indent: 0.5in">If the Registrant disposes, in one transaction
or a series of transactions, of all or substantially all of the assets of the Liberty SiriusXM Group, it is required to choose one of
the following four alternatives, unless the board obtains approval of the holders of Liberty SiriusXM common stock not to take such action
or the disposition qualifies under a specified exemption (in which case the Registrant will not be required to take any of the following
actions):</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%" STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
<TD STYLE="width: 0.25in"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 0.25in"><FONT STYLE="font-family: Symbol">&middot;</FONT></TD><TD>pay a dividend to holders of Liberty SiriusXM common stock out of the available net proceeds of such disposition; or</TD></TR></TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"></P>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%" STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
<TD STYLE="width: 0.25in"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 0.25in"><FONT STYLE="font-family: Symbol">&middot;</FONT></TD><TD>if there are legally sufficient assets and the SiriusXM Group Available Dividend Amount would have been sufficient to pay a dividend,
then: (i)&nbsp;if the disposition involves all of the properties and assets of the Liberty SiriusXM Group, redeem all outstanding shares
of Liberty SiriusXM common stock in exchange for cash and/or securities or other assets with a fair value equal to the available net proceeds
of such disposition, or (ii)&nbsp;if the disposition involves substantially all (but not all) of the properties and assets of the Liberty
SiriusXM Group, redeem a portion of the outstanding shares of Liberty SiriusXM common stock in exchange for cash and/or securities or
other assets with a fair value equal to the available net proceeds of such disposition; or</TD></TR></TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"></P>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%" STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
<TD STYLE="width: 0.25in"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 0.25in"><FONT STYLE="font-family: Symbol">&middot;</FONT></TD><TD>convert each outstanding share of each series of Liberty SiriusXM common stock into a number of shares of the corresponding series
of Liberty Live common stock and/or Liberty Formula One common stock at a specified premium; or</TD></TR></TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"></P>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%" STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
<TD STYLE="width: 0.25in"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 0.25in"><FONT STYLE="font-family: Symbol">&middot;</FONT></TD><TD>combine a conversion of a portion of the outstanding shares of Liberty SiriusXM common stock into a number of shares of the corresponding
series of Liberty Live common stock and/or Liberty Formula One common stock with either the payment of a dividend on or a redemption of
shares of Liberty SiriusXM common stock, subject to certain limitations.</TD></TR></TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"><B><I>Voting Rights</I></B></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-indent: 0.5in">Holders of Series&nbsp;A Liberty SiriusXM common
stock are entitled to one vote for each share of such stock held and holders of Series&nbsp;B Liberty SiriusXM common stock are entitled
to ten votes for each share of such stock held on all matters submitted to a vote of stockholders. Holders of Series&nbsp;C Liberty SiriusXM
common stock are not entitled to any voting powers (including with respect to any class votes taken in accordance with the terms of the
charter), except as otherwise required by Delaware law. When so required, holders of Series&nbsp;C Liberty SiriusXM common stock will
be entitled to 1/100th of a vote for each share of such stock held.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-indent: 0.5in">Holders of Liberty SiriusXM common stock will vote
as one class with holders of Liberty Live common stock and Liberty Formula One common stock on all matters that are submitted to a vote
of stockholders unless a separate class vote is required by the terms of the charter or Delaware law. In connection with certain dispositions
of Liberty SiriusXM Group assets as described above, the board may determine to seek approval of the holders of Liberty SiriusXM common
stock, voting together as a separate class, to avoid effecting a mandatory dividend, redemption or conversion under the charter.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"></P>

<!-- Field: Page; Sequence: 4; Value: 1 -->
    <DIV STYLE="margin-top: 12pt; margin-bottom: 6pt; border-bottom: Black 1pt solid"><P STYLE="font-size: 10pt; text-align: center; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt"><!-- Field: Sequence; Type: Arabic; Name: PageNo -->3<!-- Field: /Sequence -->&nbsp;</P></DIV>
    <DIV STYLE="break-before: page; margin-top: 6pt; margin-bottom: 12pt"><P STYLE="margin: 0pt">&nbsp;</P></DIV>
    <!-- Field: /Page -->

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-indent: 0.5in">The Registrant may not redeem outstanding shares
of Liberty SiriusXM common stock for shares of common stock of a subsidiary that holds assets and liabilities attributed to the Liberty
SiriusXM Group unless the board seeks and receives the approval to such redemption of holders of Liberty SiriusXM common stock, voting
together as a separate class, and, if such subsidiary also holds assets and liabilities of the Liberty Live Group and/or the Formula One
Group, the approval of holders of Liberty Live common stock and/or Liberty Formula One common stock, as the case may be, to the corresponding
Liberty Live common stock and/or Liberty Formula One common stock redemption, with each affected group voting as a separate class.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-indent: 0.5in">The charter imposes supermajority voting requirements
in connection with certain charter amendments and other extraordinary transactions which have not been approved by 75% of the directors
then in office. When these requirements apply, the threshold vote required is 66&frac23;% of the aggregate voting power of the Registrant&rsquo;s
outstanding voting securities, voting together as a single class.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"><B><I>Intergroup Interest</I></B></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-indent: 0.5in">From time to time, the board may determine to create
an intergroup interest in the Liberty SiriusXM Group in favor of the Liberty Live Group or the Formula One Group, subject to the terms
of the charter.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-indent: 0.5in">If the Liberty SiriusXM Group has an intergroup
interest in the Liberty Live Group or the Formula One Group at such time as any extraordinary action is taken with respect to the Liberty
Live common stock or the Liberty Formula One common stock (such as the payment of a dividend, a share distribution, the redemption of
such stock for stock of a subsidiary or an action required to be taken in connection with a disposition of all or substantially all of
the Liberty Live Group or the Formula One Group assets), the board will consider what actions are required, or permitted, to be taken
under the charter with respect to the Liberty SiriusXM Group&rsquo;s intergroup interest in the Liberty Live Group or the Formula One
Group. For example, in some instances, the board may determine that a portion of the aggregate consideration that is available for distribution
to holders of Liberty Live common stock or Liberty Formula One common stock must be allocated to the Liberty SiriusXM Group to compensate
the Liberty SiriusXM Group on a pro rata basis for its interest in the Liberty Live Group or the Formula One Group, as the case may be.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-indent: 0.5in">Similarly, if the Liberty Live Group or the Formula
One Group has an intergroup interest in the Liberty SiriusXM Group at such time as any extraordinary action is taken with respect to the
Liberty SiriusXM common stock (such as the payment of a dividend, a share distribution, the redemption of such stock for stock of a subsidiary
or an action required to be taken in connection with a disposition of all or substantially all of the Liberty SiriusXM Group&rsquo;s assets),
the board will consider what actions are required, or permitted, to be taken under the charter with respect to the Liberty Live Group
or the Formula One Group&rsquo;s intergroup interest in the Liberty SiriusXM Group.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-indent: 0.5in">All such board determinations will be made in accordance
with the charter and applicable Delaware law.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-indent: 0.5in">Upon the effectiveness of the charter, no group
will initially have an intergroup interest in another group.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"><B><I>Liquidation</I></B></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-indent: 0.5in">Upon the Registrant&rsquo;s liquidation, dissolution
or winding up, holders of shares of Liberty SiriusXM common stock will be entitled to receive in respect of such stock their proportionate
interests in the Registrant&rsquo;s assets, if any, remaining for distribution to holders of common stock (regardless of the group to
which such assets are then attributed) in proportion to their respective number of liquidation units per share.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-indent: 0.5in">Each share of Liberty SiriusXM common stock initially
will be entitled to a number of liquidation units as set forth on the statement to be filed with the Secretary of the Registrant as promptly
as reasonably practicable following the determination thereof following the effective date of the charter, a copy of which will be furnished
by the Registrant, on request and without cost, to any stockholder of the Registrant.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"><B><U>Liberty Live Common Stock</U></B></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"><B><I>Basic Investment</I></B></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-indent: 0.5in">The Liberty Live common stock is intended to track
and reflect the separate economic performance of the businesses, assets and liabilities attributed to the Liberty Live Group. The Liberty
Live Group is defined in the charter to include (i)&nbsp;the Registrant&rsquo;s direct and indirect interest, as of the effective date
of the charter, in Live Nation Entertainment,&nbsp;Inc. and each of its subsidiaries (including any successor to Live Nation Entertainment,&nbsp;Inc.
or any such subsidiary by merger, consolidation or sale, transfer, exchange, assignment or other disposition of all or substantially all
of its assets, whether or not in connection with a Live Group Related Business Transaction (as such term is defined in the charter)) and
their respective assets, liabilities and businesses, (ii)&nbsp;all other assets, liabilities and businesses of the Registrant or any of
its subsidiaries to the extent attributed to the Liberty Live Group as of the effective date of the charter, (iii)&nbsp;such other businesses,
assets and liabilities that the board may determine to attribute to the Liberty Live Group or that may be acquired for or transferred
to the Liberty Live Group in the future, (iv)&nbsp;the proceeds of any sale, transfer, exchange, assignment or other disposition of any
of the foregoing, (v)&nbsp;an Inter-Group Interest in the Liberty SiriusXM Group equal to one (1)&nbsp;minus the SiriusXM Group Outstanding
Interest Fraction allocable to the Liberty Live Group as of such date (as such terms are defined in the charter) and (vi)&nbsp;an Inter-Group
Interest in the Formula One Group equal to one (1)&nbsp;minus the Formula One Group Outstanding Interest Fraction allocable to the Liberty
Live Group as of such date (as such terms are defined in the charter).</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"><B><I>Authorized Capital Stock</I></B></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-indent: 0.5in">The Registrant is authorized to issue up to 1,062,352,500
shares of Liberty Live common stock, of which 521,400,000 are designated as Series&nbsp;A Liberty Live common stock, 19,552,500 are designated
as Series&nbsp;B Liberty Live common stock, and 521,400,000 are designated as Series&nbsp;C Liberty Live common stock.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"><B><I>Dividends and Securities Distributions</I></B></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-indent: 0.5in">The Registrant is permitted to pay dividends on
Liberty Live common stock out of the lesser of its assets legally available for the payment of dividends under Delaware law and the &ldquo;Live
Group Available Dividend Amount&rdquo; (defined generally as the excess of the total assets less the total liabilities of the Liberty
Live Group over the par value, or any greater amount determined to be capital in respect of, all outstanding shares of Liberty Live common
stock or, if there is no such excess, an amount equal to the earnings or loss attributable to the Liberty Live Group (if positive) for
the fiscal year in which such dividend is to be paid and/or the preceding fiscal year). If dividends are paid on any series of Liberty
Live common stock, an equal per share dividend will be concurrently paid on the other series of Liberty Live common stock.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-indent: 0.5in">The Registrant is permitted to make (i)&nbsp;share
distributions of (A)&nbsp;Series&nbsp;C Liberty Live common stock to holders of all series of Liberty Live common stock, on an equal per
share basis; and (B)&nbsp;Series&nbsp;A Liberty Live common stock to holders of Series&nbsp;A Liberty Live common stock and, on an equal
per share basis, shares of Series&nbsp;B Liberty Live common stock to holders of Series&nbsp;B Liberty Live common stock and, on an equal
per share basis, shares of Series&nbsp;C Liberty Live common stock to holders of Series&nbsp;C Liberty Live common stock; and (ii)&nbsp;share
distributions of (A)&nbsp;Series&nbsp;C Liberty SiriusXM common stock or Series&nbsp;C Liberty Formula One common stock to holders of
all series of Liberty Live common stock, on an equal per share basis, subject to certain limitations; and (B)&nbsp;Series&nbsp;A Liberty
SiriusXM common stock or Series&nbsp;A Liberty Formula One common stock to holders of Series&nbsp;A Liberty Live common stock and, on
an equal per share basis, shares of Series&nbsp;B Liberty SiriusXM common stock or Series&nbsp;B Liberty Formula One common stock to holders
of Series&nbsp;B Liberty Live common stock and, on an equal per share basis, shares of Series&nbsp;C Liberty SiriusXM common stock or
Series&nbsp;C Liberty Formula One common stock to holders of Series&nbsp;C Liberty Live common stock, in each case, subject to certain
limitations; and (iii)&nbsp;share distributions of any other class or series of the Registrant&rsquo;s securities or the securities of
any other person to holders of all series of Liberty Live common stock, on an equal per share basis, subject to certain limitations.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"></P>

<!-- Field: Page; Sequence: 6; Value: 1 -->
    <DIV STYLE="margin-top: 12pt; margin-bottom: 6pt; border-bottom: Black 1pt solid"><P STYLE="font-size: 10pt; text-align: center; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt"><!-- Field: Sequence; Type: Arabic; Name: PageNo -->5<!-- Field: /Sequence -->&nbsp;</P></DIV>
    <DIV STYLE="break-before: page; margin-top: 6pt; margin-bottom: 12pt"><P STYLE="margin: 0pt">&nbsp;</P></DIV>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"><B><I>Conversion at Option of Holder</I></B></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-indent: 0.5in">Each share of Series&nbsp;B Liberty Live common
stock is convertible, at the option of the holder, into one share of Series&nbsp;A Liberty Live common stock. Shares of Series&nbsp;A
and Series&nbsp;C Liberty Live common stock are not convertible at the option of the holder.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"><B><I>Conversion at Option of Issuer</I></B></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-indent: 0.5in">The Registrant can convert each share of Liberty
Live common stock into a number of shares of the corresponding series of Liberty SiriusXM common stock or Liberty Formula One common stock
at a ratio based on the relative trading prices of the Series&nbsp;A Liberty Live common stock (or another series of Liberty Live common
stock, subject to certain limitations) and the Series&nbsp;A Liberty SiriusXM common stock or Series&nbsp;A Liberty Formula One common
stock (or another series of Liberty SiriusXM common stock or Liberty Formula One common stock, subject to certain limitations) over a
specified 20-trading day period.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-indent: 0.5in">The Registrant also can convert each share of Liberty
SiriusXM common stock or Liberty Formula One common stock into a number of shares of the corresponding series of Liberty Live common stock
at a ratio based on the relative trading prices of the Series&nbsp;A Liberty SiriusXM common stock (or another series of Liberty SiriusXM
common stock, subject to certain limitations) or Series&nbsp;A Liberty Formula One common stock (or another series of Liberty Formula
One common stock, subject to certain limitations) to the Series&nbsp;A Liberty Live common stock (or another series of Liberty Live common
stock, subject to certain limitations) over a specified 20-trading day period.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"><B><I>Optional Redemption for Stock of a Subsidiary</I></B></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-indent: 0.5in">The Registrant may redeem outstanding shares of
Liberty Live common stock for shares of common stock of a subsidiary that holds assets and liabilities attributed to the Liberty Live
Group (and may or may not hold assets and liabilities attributed to the Liberty SiriusXM Group or the Formula One Group), provided that
the board seeks and receives the approval to such redemption of holders of Liberty Live common stock, voting together as a separate class.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-indent: 0.5in">If the Registrant were to effect a redemption as
described above with stock of a subsidiary that also holds assets and liabilities of the Liberty SiriusXM Group and/or the Formula One
Group, shares of Liberty SiriusXM common stock and/or Liberty Formula One common stock would also be redeemed in exchange for shares of
that subsidiary, and the entire redemption would be subject to the voting rights of the holders of Liberty Live common stock described
above as well as the separate class vote of the holders of Liberty SiriusXM common stock and/or Liberty Formula One common stock, as the
case may be.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"><B><I>Mandatory Dividend, Redemption and Conversion Rights on Disposition
of Assets</I></B></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-indent: 0.5in">If the Registrant disposes, in one transaction
or a series of transactions, of all or substantially all of the assets of the Liberty Live Group, it is required to choose one of the
following four alternatives, unless the board obtains approval of the holders of Liberty Live common stock not to take such action or
the disposition qualifies under a specified exemption (in which case the Registrant will not be required to take any of the following
actions):</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%" STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
<TD STYLE="width: 0.25in"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 0.25in"><FONT STYLE="font-family: Symbol">&middot;</FONT></TD><TD>pay a dividend to holders of Liberty Live common stock out of the available net proceeds of such disposition; or</TD></TR></TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"></P>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%" STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
<TD STYLE="width: 0.25in"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 0.25in"><FONT STYLE="font-family: Symbol">&middot;</FONT></TD><TD>if there are legally sufficient assets and the Liberty Live Group Available Dividend Amount would have been sufficient to pay a dividend,
then: (i)&nbsp;if the disposition involves all of the properties and assets of the Liberty Live Group, redeem all outstanding shares of
Liberty Live common stock in exchange for cash and/or securities or other assets with a fair value equal to the available net proceeds
of such disposition, or (ii)&nbsp;if the disposition involves substantially all (but not all) of the properties and assets of the Liberty
Live Group, redeem a portion of the outstanding shares of Liberty Live common stock in exchange for cash and/or securities or other assets
with a fair value equal to the available net proceeds of such disposition; or</TD></TR></TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"></P>

<!-- Field: Page; Sequence: 7; Value: 1 -->
    <DIV STYLE="margin-top: 12pt; margin-bottom: 6pt; border-bottom: Black 1pt solid"><P STYLE="font-size: 10pt; text-align: center; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt"><!-- Field: Sequence; Type: Arabic; Name: PageNo -->6<!-- Field: /Sequence -->&nbsp;</P></DIV>
    <DIV STYLE="break-before: page; margin-top: 6pt; margin-bottom: 12pt"><P STYLE="margin: 0pt">&nbsp;</P></DIV>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%" STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
<TD STYLE="width: 0.25in"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 0.25in"><FONT STYLE="font-family: Symbol">&middot;</FONT></TD><TD>convert each outstanding share of each series of Liberty Live common stock into a number of shares of the corresponding series of
Liberty SiriusXM common stock and/or Liberty Formula One common stock at a specified premium; or</TD></TR></TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"></P>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%" STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
<TD STYLE="width: 0.25in"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 0.25in"><FONT STYLE="font-family: Symbol">&middot;</FONT></TD><TD>combine a conversion of a portion of the outstanding shares of Liberty Live common stock into a number of shares of the corresponding
series of Liberty SiriusXM common stock and/or Liberty Formula One common stock with either the payment of a dividend on or a redemption
of shares of Liberty Live common stock, subject to certain limitations.</TD></TR></TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"><B><I>Voting Rights</I></B></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-indent: 0.5in">Holders of Series&nbsp;A Liberty Live common stock
are entitled to one vote for each share of such stock held and holders of Series&nbsp;B Liberty Live common stock are entitled to ten
votes for each share of such stock held on all matters submitted to a vote of stockholders. Holders of Series&nbsp;C Liberty Live common
stock are not entitled to any voting powers (including with respect to any class votes taken in accordance with the terms of the charter),
except as otherwise required by Delaware law. When so required, holders of Series&nbsp;C Liberty Live common stock will be entitled to
1/100th of a vote for each share of such stock held.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-indent: 0.5in">Holders of Liberty Live common stock will vote
as one class with holders of Liberty SiriusXM common stock and Liberty Formula One common stock on all matters that are submitted to a
vote of stockholders unless a separate class vote is required by the terms of the charter or Delaware law. In connection with certain
dispositions of Liberty Live Group assets as described above, the board may determine to seek approval of the holders of Liberty Live
common stock, voting together as a separate class, to avoid effecting a mandatory dividend, redemption or conversion under the charter.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-indent: 0.5in">The Registrant may not redeem outstanding shares
of Liberty Live common stock for shares of common stock of a subsidiary that holds assets and liabilities attributed to the Liberty Live
Group unless the board seeks and receives the approval to such redemption of holders of Liberty Live common stock, voting together as
a separate class, and, if such subsidiary also holds assets and liabilities of the Liberty SiriusXM Group and/or the Formula One Group,
the approval of holders of Liberty SiriusXM common stock and/or Liberty Formula One common stock, as the case may be, to the corresponding
Liberty SiriusXM common stock and/or Liberty Formula One common stock redemption, with each affected group voting as a separate class.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-indent: 0.5in">The charter imposes supermajority voting requirements
in connection with certain charter amendments and other extraordinary transactions which have not been approved by 75% of the directors
then in office. When these requirements apply, the threshold vote required is 66&frac23;% of the aggregate voting power of the Registrant&rsquo;s
outstanding voting securities, voting together as a single class.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"><B><I>Intergroup Interest</I></B></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-indent: 0.5in">From time to time, the board may determine to create
an intergroup interest in the Liberty Live Group in favor of the Liberty SiriusXM Group or the Formula One Group, subject to the terms
of the charter.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-indent: 0.5in">If the Liberty Live Group has an intergroup interest
in the Liberty SiriusXM Group or the Formula One Group at such time as any extraordinary action is taken with respect to the Liberty SiriusXM
common stock or the Liberty Formula One common stock (such as the payment of a dividend, a share distribution, the redemption of such
stock for stock of a subsidiary or an action required to be taken in connection with a disposition of all or substantially all of the
Liberty SiriusXM Group or the Formula One Group assets), the board will consider what actions are required, or permitted, to be taken
under the charter with respect to the Liberty Live Group&rsquo;s intergroup interest in the Liberty SiriusXM Group or the Formula One
Group. For example, in some instances, the board may determine that a portion of the aggregate consideration that is available for distribution
to holders of Liberty SiriusXM common stock or Liberty Formula One common stock must be allocated to the Liberty Live Group to compensate
the Liberty Live Group on a pro rata basis for its interest in the Liberty SiriusXM Group or the Formula One Group, as the case may be.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"></P>

<!-- Field: Page; Sequence: 8; Value: 1 -->
    <DIV STYLE="margin-top: 12pt; margin-bottom: 6pt; border-bottom: Black 1pt solid"><P STYLE="font-size: 10pt; text-align: center; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt"><!-- Field: Sequence; Type: Arabic; Name: PageNo -->7<!-- Field: /Sequence -->&nbsp;</P></DIV>
    <DIV STYLE="break-before: page; margin-top: 6pt; margin-bottom: 12pt"><P STYLE="margin: 0pt">&nbsp;</P></DIV>
    <!-- Field: /Page -->

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-indent: 0.5in">Similarly, if the Liberty SiriusXM Group or the
Formula One Group has an intergroup interest in the Liberty Live Group at such time as any extraordinary action is taken with respect
to the Liberty Live common stock (such as the payment of a dividend, a share distribution, the redemption of such stock for stock of a
subsidiary or an action required to be taken in connection with a disposition of all or substantially all of the Liberty Live Group&rsquo;s
assets), the board will consider what actions are required, or permitted, to be taken under the charter with respect to the Liberty SiriusXM
Group or the Formula One Group&rsquo;s intergroup interest in the Liberty Live Group.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-indent: 0.5in">All such board determinations will be made in accordance
with the charter and applicable Delaware law.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-indent: 0.5in">Upon the effectiveness of the charter, no group
will initially have an intergroup interest in another group.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"><B><I>Liquidation</I></B></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-indent: 0.5in">Upon the Registrant&rsquo;s liquidation, dissolution
or winding up, holders of shares of Liberty Live common stock will be entitled to receive in respect of such stock their proportionate
interests in the Registrant&rsquo;s assets, if any, remaining for distribution to holders of common stock (regardless of the group to
which such assets are then attributed) in proportion to their respective number of liquidation units per share.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-indent: 0.5in">Each share of Liberty Live common stock initially
will be entitled to a number of liquidation units as set forth on the statement to be filed with the Secretary of the Registrant as promptly
as reasonably practicable following the determination thereof following the effective date of the charter, a copy of which will be furnished
by the Registrant, on request and without cost, to any stockholder of the Registrant.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"><B><U>Liberty Formula One Common Stock</U></B></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"><B><I>Basic Investment</I></B></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-indent: 0.5in">The Liberty Formula One common stock is intended
to track and reflect the separate economic performance of the business, assets and liabilities attributed to the Formula One Group. The
Formula One Group is defined in the charter to include (i)&nbsp;the Registrant&rsquo;s direct and indirect interest, as of the effective
date of the charter, in (x)&nbsp;all of the businesses in which the Registrant is or has been engaged, directly or indirectly (either
itself or through direct or indirect subsidiaries, affiliates, joint ventures or other investments or any of the predecessors or successors
of any of the foregoing), and (y)&nbsp;the respective assets and liabilities of the Registrant and its subsidiaries, in each case, other
than any businesses, assets or liabilities attributable to the Liberty SiriusXM Group or the Liberty Live Group as of the effective date
of the charter, (ii)&nbsp;such other businesses, assets and liabilities that the board may determine to attribute to the Formula One Group
or that may be acquired for or transferred to the Formula One Group in the future, (iii)&nbsp;the proceeds of any sale, transfer, exchange,
assignment or other disposition of any of the foregoing, (iv)&nbsp;an Inter-Group Interest in the Liberty SiriusXM Group equal to one
(1)&nbsp;minus the SiriusXM Group Outstanding Interest Fraction allocable to the Formula One Group as of such date and (v)&nbsp;an Inter-Group
Interest in the Liberty Live Group equal to one (1)&nbsp;minus the Live Group Outstanding Interest Fraction allocable to the Formula One
Group as of such date.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"><B><I>Authorized Capital Stock</I></B></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-indent: 0.5in">The Registrant is authorized to issue up to 1,018,750,000
shares of Liberty Formula One common stock, of which 500 million are designated as Series&nbsp;A Liberty Formula One common stock, 18,750,000
are designated as Series&nbsp;B Liberty Formula One common stock, and 500 million are designated as Series&nbsp;C Liberty Formula One
common stock.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"><B><I>Dividends and Securities Distributions</I></B></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-indent: 0.5in">The Registrant is permitted to pay dividends on
Liberty Formula One common stock out of the lesser of its assets legally available for the payment of dividends under Delaware law and
the &ldquo;Formula One Group Available Dividend Amount&rdquo; (defined generally as the excess of the total assets less the total liabilities
of the Formula One Group over the par value, or any greater amount determined to be capital in respect of, all outstanding shares of Liberty
Formula One common stock or, if there is no such excess, an amount equal to the earnings or loss attributable to the Formula One Group
(if positive) for the fiscal year in which such dividend is to be paid and/or the preceding fiscal year). If dividends are paid on any
series of Liberty Formula One common stock, an equal per share dividend will be concurrently paid on the other series of Liberty Formula
One common stock.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"></P>

<!-- Field: Page; Sequence: 9; Value: 1 -->
    <DIV STYLE="margin-top: 12pt; margin-bottom: 6pt; border-bottom: Black 1pt solid"><P STYLE="font-size: 10pt; text-align: center; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt"><!-- Field: Sequence; Type: Arabic; Name: PageNo -->8<!-- Field: /Sequence -->&nbsp;</P></DIV>
    <DIV STYLE="break-before: page; margin-top: 6pt; margin-bottom: 12pt"><P STYLE="margin: 0pt">&nbsp;</P></DIV>
    <!-- Field: /Page -->

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-indent: 0.5in">The Registrant is permitted to make (i)&nbsp;share
distributions of (A)&nbsp;Series&nbsp;C Liberty Formula One common stock to holders of all series of Liberty Formula One common stock,
on an equal per share basis; and (B)&nbsp;Series&nbsp;A Liberty Formula One common stock to holders of Series&nbsp;A Liberty Formula One
common stock and, on an equal per share basis, shares of Series&nbsp;B Liberty Formula One common stock to holders of Series&nbsp;B Liberty
Formula One common stock and, on an equal per share basis, shares of Series&nbsp;C Liberty Formula One common stock to holders of Series&nbsp;C
Liberty Formula One common stock; and (ii)&nbsp;share distributions of (A)&nbsp;Series&nbsp;C Liberty SiriusXM common stock or Series&nbsp;C
Liberty Live common stock to holders of all series of Liberty Formula One common stock, on an equal per share basis, subject to certain
limitations; and (B)&nbsp;Series&nbsp;A Liberty SiriusXM common stock or Series&nbsp;A Liberty Live common stock to holders of Series&nbsp;A
Liberty Formula One common stock and, on an equal per share basis, shares of Series&nbsp;B Liberty SiriusXM common stock or Series&nbsp;B
Liberty Live common stock to holders of Series&nbsp;B Liberty Formula One common stock and, on an equal per share basis, shares of Series&nbsp;C
Liberty SiriusXM common stock or Series&nbsp;C Liberty Live common stock to holders of Series&nbsp;C Liberty Formula One common stock,
in each case, subject to certain limitations; and (iii)&nbsp;share distributions of any other class or series of the Registrant&rsquo;s
securities or the securities of any other person to holders of all series of Liberty Formula One common stock, on an equal per share basis,
subject to certain limitations.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"><B><I>Conversion at Option of Holder</I></B></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-indent: 0.5in">Each share of Series&nbsp;B Liberty Formula One
common stock is convertible, at the option of the holder, into one share of Series&nbsp;A Liberty Formula One common stock. Shares of
Series&nbsp;A and Series&nbsp;C Liberty Formula One common stock are not convertible at the option of the holder.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"><B><I>Conversion at Option of Issuer</I></B></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-indent: 0.5in">The Registrant can convert each share of Liberty
Formula One common stock into a number of shares of the corresponding series of Liberty SiriusXM common stock or Liberty Live common stock
at a ratio based on the relative trading prices of the Series&nbsp;A Liberty Formula One common stock (or another series of Liberty Formula
One common stock, subject to certain limitations) and the Series&nbsp;A Liberty SiriusXM common stock or Series&nbsp;A Liberty Live common
stock (or another series of Liberty SiriusXM common stock or Liberty Live common stock, subject to certain limitations) over a specified
20-trading day period.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-indent: 0.5in">The Registrant also can convert each share of Liberty
SiriusXM common stock or Liberty Live common stock into a number of shares of the corresponding series of Liberty Formula One common stock
at a ratio based on the relative trading prices of the Series&nbsp;A Liberty SiriusXM common stock (or another series of Liberty SiriusXM
common stock, subject to certain limitations) or Series&nbsp;A Liberty Live common stock (or another series of Liberty Live common stock,
subject to certain limitations) to the Series&nbsp;A Liberty Formula One common stock (or another series of Liberty Formula One common
stock, subject to certain limitations) over a specified 20-trading day period.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"><B><I>Optional Redemption for Stock of a Subsidiary</I></B></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-indent: 0.5in">The Registrant may redeem outstanding shares of
Liberty Formula One common stock for shares of common stock of a subsidiary that holds assets and liabilities attributed to the Formula
One Group (and may or may not hold assets and liabilities attributed to the Liberty SiriusXM Group or the Liberty Live Group), provided
that the board seeks and receives the approval to such redemption of holders of Liberty Formula One common stock, voting together as a
separate class.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-indent: 0.5in">If the Registrant were to effect a redemption as
described above with stock of a subsidiary that also holds assets and liabilities of the Liberty SiriusXM Group and/or the Liberty Live
Group, shares of Liberty SiriusXM common stock and/or Liberty Live common stock would also be redeemed in exchange for shares of that
subsidiary, and the entire redemption would be subject to the voting rights of the holders of Liberty Formula One common stock described
above as well as the separate class vote of the holders of Liberty SiriusXM common stock and/or Liberty Live common stock, as the case
may be.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"></P>
